summary: Repaired ten reported PMConcept7 Home regressions and replaced the surface movement affordance. Nine of the ten were caused by the Home projection layer overriding the shell it sits on (blanket !important sizing over reparented surfaces, flex sizing on grid items, controls mounted over existing chrome, and capture-phase click hijacks), not by missing features. Movement is now direct manipulation from a top-left grab handle with a lifted item, an in-flow placeholder and live neighbour reflow, plus a keyboard path; the centre-screen target-picker rail is retired along with the 77 per-surface move/redock wiring rows. Adds the contact-aware editor tab silhouette (F3-505) and moves the title-bar notification stack after the search field. Command, event, receipt, schema and storage contracts are unchanged.

checks.details: Concepts/pm7-tools/verify/home_workspace_matrix.mjs reports 22/22 checks and the exact 72-case fresh-context visual matrix with zero console or page errors against the shipped artifact. The rewritten fixtures assert observable outcomes: resize asserts changed rendered geometry (excusing only surfaces whose host is over-subscribed), move asserts a lifted item, a placeholder seated in the target host and a mid-drag change in some neighbour's layout position (offsetLeft/offsetTop, so the FLIP transform cannot fake it; the transform itself is recorded alongside as evidence the reflow is animated), collapse asserts panel height on both sides of the toggle, and open-in-panel asserts the rendered buffer in all four panels.

checks.name: editor-tab-silhouette-eight-theme-audit
checks.details: 13/13 packet-requirement checks across all eight themes plus reduced motion: the silhouette and the code canvas resolve to an identical paint stack over a shared opaque ground (glass adopts its own near-opaque plate as that fill, so the two no longer composite over different backdrops), the rail is darker in every theme by a mean channel step of 5.9-20.4/255, no seam at the join, unselected tabs paint their own quiet chip and de-emphasised label, editor tabs are keyboard-focusable with Enter/Space activation and arrow roving producing the identical shape transition, reduced motion snaps without spring travel, and the shape recomputes stable bounds on window resize.

checks.name: editor-tab-silhouette-frame-step-and-pixel-sample
checks.details: Frame-stepped every rAF tick of a click-to-select transition and recomputed the corner geometry from each frame's own position: 16/16 checks over four themes, worst drift 0.0003px, zero one-frame corner pops, zero degenerate frames. This is how a real defect surfaced: the re-render's snap-sync was landing before the animated one, so the silhouette teleported between tabs instead of springing; a selection change now always springs while layout-driven syncs still snap. Pixel-sampled 24 join crops (8 themes x flush-left / interior / flush-right) at 4x device scale with a stdlib PNG decoder: 24/24 free of hairline seams. Detection required three discriminators because the naive test is defeated by tab-label ink flush to the join, by ordinary step and curved boundaries, and by retro's periodic phosphor grid, which is genuine theme texture in both axes rather than a seam.
